title: Access Coordinator: lightweight policy adjudicator + attachable audit proxy for API/Runtime/Console
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Build an Access Coordinator service that provides a fast, pluggable policy adjudicator (decision API) and an attachable audit proxy that can be inserted across Redwood API, runtime, and Console traffic. Goals: reduce policy-eval latency for hot paths, provide a single enforcement point for RBAC v2 semantics, and emit rich audit events that satisfy enterprise compliance requirements (immutable event ids, user/session context, policy decision trace).

Scope: lightweight gRPC/HTTP decision API, in-process middleware shim for runtime, sidecar-compatible audit proxy for hosted and private deployments, SAML/SSO mapping hooks, admin controls for emergency overrides and role rollout. This ticket covers MVP API surface, high-level schema for audit events, and integration stubs for Console and Hosted API routes.
comments: 2026-02-12 - Aisha K.: Kickoff meeting notes uploaded to Confluence (link below). Agreed scope: no global policy language in MVP, start with declarative role -> resource/action allow/deny and obligations for audit tagging.

2026-02-18 - Riley C.: Spike results: in-memory decision cache reduces median eval latency from 3.8ms to 0.6ms for cached tokens; cache hit rate depends on role cardinality. Decided to implement LFU cache with TTL and explicit invalidation hooks from admin console.

2026-02-22 - Eng Review (Samir G.): Raised concern about audit event size and storage costs. Suggested event sampling for low-risk operations and full fidelity for admin/privileged actions. Follow-up: add sampling flags and compression for payloads.

2026-02-28 - Devops (Jordan P.): Confirmed sidecar design for Private/VPC will require edgeless TLS cert rotation and metrics endpoints. Action: design health and readiness probes for sidecar and add mTLS optional mode.

2026-03-03 - PM Review (Miguel S.): Asked for explicit SSO mapping flow: how SAML assertions map to internal principal attributes and roles. Added a subtask to document mapping conventions and schema for external identity providers.

2026-03-07 - Security Review (Elena R.): Requested threat model for decision API (replay, tampering) and suggested HMAC-signed audit envelopes. Marked security_review_required=true. Action: add envelope HMAC and rotation plan to design doc.

2026-03-10 - Riley C.: Implemented proof-of-concept decision API and audit proxy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rbac-coordinator/pull/127. Integration tests added for API, runtime shim, and Console login flows. Performance benchmark results uploaded to internal dashboard.

2026-03-12 - Design feedback (Nina L.): Console UX needs an emergency override toggle and role rollout visualizer. Created DES-1042 to handle UI. Also recommended clear explanation of what constitutes 'admin' in audit events.

Follow-ups planned: - Add invalidation webhook for cache when role bindings change - Add sampling policy config and storage cost estimator - Finalize SAML mapping spec and add example IdP manifests - Run SOC audit sim with audit events exported to external SIEM
